question: Should gateway restart audits retain raw actor, device ID, client IP, changed paths, and non-secret preflight metadata for the latest 512 events?
rationale: Source review establishes that secrets and session keys are sanitized, but current main does not define this new durable local attribution and retention contract; choosing that privacy boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve metadata-only ledger
options.body: Keep the fixed 512-row local ledger with the current non-secret attribution fields and document this privacy boundary.

options.title: Narrow attribution fields
options.body: Persist only source, reason, timing, normalized blocker counts, and fingerprinted identifiers.

options.title: Defer durable auditing
options.body: Pause persistent restart auditing until a broader repository audit-data policy is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve metadata-only ledger
recommendation.body: Keep the fixed 512-row local ledger with the current non-secret attribution fields and document this privacy boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined history signal across restart behavior, shared-state schema, and the adjacent audit-policy discussion.
